flagged_weeks.flag: Reported as exactly 5,000 cases; the next briefing's change implies 4,997.
flagged_weeks.notes: Briefing 20 Apr (Songkran week). Comparison period stated as '4-11 เม.ย.'. Highest-loss amount rounded ('กว่า 102 ล้าน', 184 cases). Conflicts: 397,413,314-269,445,711 = -127,967,603 vs stated -129,989,245; next week's stated changes imply 4,997 cases and 268,920,990 baht for this week. 5,000 cases also in Thai PBS Verify and police PR (saranitet 62096).

flagged_weeks.notes: SUSPECT FIGURES as published by ACSC (identical in Thairath 2954877, Thaitabloid 314005, police PR https://saranitet.police.go.th/commanders-mission/crime-prevention-and-suppression_24082026_67646/).
